## Gong et al. (2004), shock-derived adiabatic BM3

**untested** (not refittable) · `mg092fe008sio3_bridgmanite_gong_2004_adiabatic_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mg092fe008sio3_bridgmanite.md#record-mg092fe008sio3_bridgmanite_gong_2004_adiabatic_bm3)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The tabulated P-density observations are Hugoniot states, whereas this BM3 is a shock-reduced reference isentrope. Directly fitting the Hugoniot states to this isentrope is not a source-EOS reproduction. The thermal reduction inputs are not recoverable from this table; retain the shock observations without an invalid isentropic regression.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mg092fe008sio3\_gong\_2004\_table1\_shock
